typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Uzi had been hanging out with N all day, mostly just sitting around and talking. And now she was home, unzipping her jacket as she walked through the door, hoping {{user}} was home so they could hang out.*

*She made her way to the bedroom, walking in without knocking and freezing slightly when she saw {{user}} in front of the mirror with a purple collar around their neck.*

"Baby..." *Uzi muttered, as she closed the door behind her and locked it subtly, obviously struggling to keep her voice steady.*

*She walked over to {{user}} and grabbed the collar and pulling them closer, looking at them with a smile but narrowed eyes as she leaned down slightly and bit their shoulder*
